theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 11 群

items.colloc: be closely related to 密切相關 | be directly related to 直接相關
items.distinct: relate to 敘述；聯繫 | refer to 提及；參考
ex: This issue is related to the new policy.
此議題與新政策有關。
Are these documents related to the merger?
這些文件與合併案相關嗎？
Our sales figures are related to marketing.
我們的銷售數字與行銷有關。

items.colloc: be spread out across 分佈在...各處 | be spread out over 期間跨越
items.distinct: scatter 分散（隨意）| distribute 分配；分發
ex: The branch offices are spread out globally.
各分公司分佈於全球各地。
Employees are spread out across the building.
員工們分散在整棟建築中。
The costs are spread out over three years.
費用分攤在三年內支付。

items.colloc: be tired of waiting 厭倦等待 | be tired of doing something 厭倦做某事
items.distinct: be tired from 因...感到疲憊 | be fed up with 對...忍無可忍
ex: I am tired of these endless meetings.
我對這些沒完沒了的會議感到厭倦。
They are tired of receiving constant complaints.
他們厭倦了不斷收到投訴。
Are you tired of working from home?
你對居家辦公感到厭倦了嗎？

items.colloc: fall behind schedule 進度落後 | remain behind schedule 依然落後
items.distinct: ahead of schedule 超前進度 | on schedule 按時
ex: The construction project is behind schedule.
這項營建專案進度落後。
We are currently behind schedule on delivery.
我們目前的交貨進度落後。
The development team is slightly behind schedule.
開發團隊的進度稍微落後。

items.colloc: report to the board of directors 向董事會報告 | a meeting of the board of directors 董事會會議
items.distinct: executive board 執行委員會 | board member 董事成員
ex: The board of directors approved the budget.
董事會批准了這份預算。
He will present the report to the board of directors.
他將向董事會提交報告。
The board of directors meets every quarter.
董事會每季召開一次會議。

items.colloc: large body of water 大片水域 | nearby body of water 附近水域
items.distinct: reservoir 水庫 | fountain 噴泉
ex: The hotel overlooks a large body of water.
這家飯店俯瞰著一大片水域。
Construction near any body of water is restricted.
在任何水域附近進行施工都受限。
This region has a significant body of water.
該地區擁有一片重要的水域。

items.colloc: reach the break even point 達到損益平衡 | calculate the break even point 計算損益平衡點
items.distinct: break even v. 達到損益平衡 | profit margin 利潤率
ex: The company expects to reach the break even point soon.
公司預期很快就能達到損益平衡。
We have calculated the break even point for this product.
我們已經算出該產品的損益平衡點。
Sales have not yet reached the break even point.
銷售額尚未達到損益平衡點。

items.colloc: study business management 修習企業管理 | effective business management 有效的企業管理
items.distinct: business administration 企業行政 | business operations 業務營運
ex: She has a degree in business management.
她擁有企業管理學位。
Effective business management is crucial for growth.
有效的企業管理對成長至關重要。
He is attending a workshop on business management.
他正在參加一場關於企業管理的研討會。

items.colloc: by way of email 透過電子郵件 | by way of introduction 作為介紹
items.distinct: by means of 藉由...方法 | in the way of 關於；礙事
ex: We traveled to Tokyo by way of Seoul.
我們經由首爾前往東京。
I received the news by way of a memo.
我透過備忘錄收到這則消息。
They sent the payment by way of wire transfer.
他們透過電匯發送款項。

items.colloc: call an urgent meeting to discuss 召開緊急會議討論 | attend an urgent meeting 出席緊急會議
items.distinct: schedule a meeting 排定會議 | convene a meeting 召集會議
ex: The manager decided to call an urgent meeting.
經理決定召開一場緊急會議。
We must call an urgent meeting regarding the crisis.
我們必須針對這次危機召開緊急會議。
Management called an urgent meeting this afternoon.
管理層今天下午召開了緊急會議。

items.colloc: call off the strike 取消罷工 | call off the meeting 取消會議
items.distinct: cancel 取消（更常用）| postpone 延期
ex: They had to call off the outdoor event.
他們不得不取消戶外活動。
The negotiations were called off yesterday.
談判在昨天被取消了。
We decided to call off the training session.
我們決定取消培訓課程。

items.zh: 進行市場調查；執行市場研究
items.colloc: carry out detailed market studies 進行詳盡的市場研究 | outsource market studies 外包市場研究
items.distinct: conduct research 進行研究 | analyze market trends 分析市場趨勢
ex: The team will carry out market studies next month.
團隊下個月將進行市場研究。
We need to carry out market studies before launching.
產品上市前我們必須進行市場調查。
They carry out market studies to identify needs.
他們透過市場研究來確認需求。

items.colloc: maintain cash reserves 維持現金儲備 | dip into cash reserves 動用現金儲備
items.distinct: cash flow 現金流 | savings 存款
ex: The firm has sufficient cash reserves for growth.
該公司擁有充足的現金儲備以求成長。
We should increase our cash reserves this year.
我們今年應該增加現金儲備。
He decided to use the cash reserves for investment.
他決定動用現金儲備進行投資。

items.colloc: charge for services 提供服務收費 | extra charge for 額外費用
items.distinct: bill for 開帳單 | cost n. 成本
ex: Do you charge for shipping and handling?
你們收取運費與處理費嗎？
The hotel does not charge for breakfast.
這家飯店不收取早餐費用。
We only charge for the materials used.
我們僅收取所用材料的費用。

items.colloc: contact the claims department 聯繫理賠部門 | work in the claims department 在理賠部門工作
items.distinct: insurance company 保險公司 | customer service 客服部
ex: Please forward your documents to the claims department.
請將您的文件轉寄給理賠部門。
I spoke with someone in the claims department.
我與理賠部門的人員通過話。
The claims department is reviewing your application.
理賠部門正在審核您的申請案。

items.colloc: lease commercial space 租賃商用空間 | prime commercial space 優質商用空間
items.distinct: office space 辦公空間 | residential area 住宅區
ex: They are looking for larger commercial space.
他們正在尋找更大的商用空間。
This area is perfect for retail commercial space.
這塊區域非常適合做零售商用空間。
Commercial space rents have increased this quarter.
本季商用空間租金上漲了。

items.colloc: for commercial use 用於商業目的 | approved for commercial use 核准用於商業用途
items.distinct: personal use 個人用途 | industrial use 工業用途
ex: This building is designated for commercial use.
這棟建築被指定用於商業用途。
The software is not licensed for commercial use.
此軟體未授權用於商業用途。
We converted the garage for commercial use.
我們將車庫改為商業用途。

items.colloc: follow company regulations 遵守公司規定 | violate company regulations 違反公司規定
items.distinct: company policy 公司政策 | local laws 地方法規
ex: Employees must follow all company regulations.
員工必須遵守所有公司規定。
These actions violate our company regulations.
這些行為違反了我們的公司規定。
Please review the company regulations manual.
請查閱公司規章手冊。

items.colloc: safely cross the street 安全過馬路 | wait to cross the street 等待過馬路
items.distinct: walk along the street 沿著街道走 | across the street 在街道對面
ex: You can cross the street at the light.
你可以在紅綠燈處過馬路。
We watched them cross the street together.
我們看著他們一起過馬路。
Be careful when you cross the street here.
在這裡過馬路時要小心。

items.colloc: cut down on expenses 削減開支 | cut down on sugar 減少糖分
items.distinct: cut off 中斷；切斷 | cut out 刪除；戒除
ex: We need to cut down on unnecessary spending.
我們需要削減不必要的開支。
The company will cut down the production time.
公司將會縮短生產時間。
It is time to cut down on overtime hours.
現在是減少加班時數的時候了。
